name: Kallow Heavy Sweatpant
description: Thick loopback cotton-blend sweatpants with a wide waistband and deep pockets. Cut generously — not slim, not tapered, just comfortable. The fabric is heavy enough to hold warmth in M88's cold seasons. Available in black, charcoal, and a faded burgundy that looks like it's been washed a hundred times.
what_it_says: You're home, or you wish you were. No performance here.
worn_by: night-shift workers coming off a long run
story_hooks: Worn to a meeting someone clearly didn't expect to have — the mismatch between clothing and situation says everything about urgency.
The faded burgundy colorway matches a decommissioned Shelf community shelter uniform, which means something to people who were there.

physical_description.visual_profile: Relaxed, voluminous silhouette with a distinctly utilitarian streetwear aesthetic. The wide waistband creates a confident stance; the generous cut through hip and thigh reads as deliberately anti-fitted, emphasizing comfort over fashion theater. Worn by off-shift warehouse workers, independent contractors, and tier 3-4 residents who value thermal efficiency.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with a straight leg, no taper. Wide, structured waistband sits naturally at the natural waist. Inseam length standard to ankle with slight break. Designed to layer over temperature-regulating undergarments or light armor.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy loopback cotton-blend (approximately 70% organic cotton, 30% recycled polyester). Substantial weight at 380-420 gsm.
physical_description.texture: Soft, brushed interior with visible loopback construction. Exterior presents a subtle ribbed weave. After multiple wash cycles, develops a lived-in patina with slight pilling at friction points. Tactile and forgiving.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three variants: deep black (most common, hides stains), neutral charcoal (mid-tone, practical), and faded burgundy (signature 'worn hundred times' appearance with uneven color fade suggesting authentic age or intentional wash-treatment).
physical_description.closures: Traditional elasticated waistband with internal drawstring (durable synthetic cord, matte black). No zipper fly — direct pull-on entry.
distinctive_features: Deep side pockets cut generously to accommodate tech, tools, or personal items
Reinforced pocket bags in ballistic-weave composite
Subtle 'KALLOW' script embroidered on right thigh in matte gray thread
Hidden interior security pocket (left hip, barely visible)
Crotch gusset reinforcement — evidence of design for movement and durability
Slight asymmetrical wear patterns on the faded burgundy variant suggesting authentic multiple-wash history
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional wear. Affordable, durable, designed for working-class bodies. Not aspirational to higher tiers; not salvage tier. Honest utility.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by dock workers, maintenance crews, independent contractors in the GLMZ ungoverned zones, and anyone operating in cold-season environments (M88's autumn/winter). Signals: 'I work. I move. I don't care about fashion cycles.' Acceptable in semi-formal working-class settings; invisible in corpo boardrooms.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in on arrival. The faded burgundy variant appears deliberately aged; black and charcoal variants show honest wear — slight pulls, faded seams, authentic patina after 6–12 months of regular use.
